Regarder la météo
```{r}

read_meteo <- function(link){
  data <- read_excel(link, col_names = FALSE) |> 
    mutate_all(as.character) |> 
    as.data.frame()
  
  
  data <- data[-dim(data)[1], ]
  ph <- which(data[4, ] == "Photoperiode")
  data <- data[, -((ph + 1): dim(data)[2])]
  
  iT <- which(data[1, ] == "TEMPERATURE")
  iEH <- which(data[1, ] == "ETAT HYDRIQUE")
  iR <- which(data[1, ] == "RAYONNEMENT")
  iF <- length(data[1, ])
  iL <- c(rep("", iT-1), rep("TEMP_", iEH - iT), rep("E.HYD_", iR - iEH), rep("RAYO_", iF - iR), "")
  
  colnames(data) <- as.character(paste0(iL, as.vector(data[4, ])))
  
  data <- data[-c(1:4), ]
  
  data <- data[!is.na(data[[7]]), ]
  
  data <- data |> 
    filter(! is.na(DATE))
  
  data <- data[, -c(1:2)]  # 2 ->3
  
  data <- data |> mutate_all(as.numeric)
  data <- data |> mutate(DATE = as_date(DATE, origin = "1899-12-30"))
}

```

# Visualisation Météo

```{r}

graph_meteo <- dt_meteo  |> 
  mutate(
    m = month(DATE),
    d = day(DATE),
    fake_year = if_else(
      (m > 8) | (m == 8 & d >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    date_no_year = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year, m, d))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date_no_year, y = TEMP_T_Q, color = exp, group = exp)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Date (sans année)", y = "Valeur") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%d-%b",
    limits = as.Date(c("2000-08-15", "2001-08-15"))
  )

graph_meteo

```



# lecture landmarks

```{r}

landmarks <- read_excel("data/Date_landmarks_20essais.xlsx") |>
  select(PARTENAIRE, ENVIRONNEMENT, YEAR, DEBUT_CW, FIN_CW, FLORAISON, DUREE_CW, DUREE_FLO)

```


Durée de chaque période
```{r}

landmarks |> 
  select(YEAR, ENVIRONNEMENT, DUREE_CW, DUREE_FLO) |> 
  pivot_longer(c(DUREE_CW, DUREE_FLO), names_to = "DUREE") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = value, colour = ENVIRONNEMENT)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~DUREE)

```
La floraison dure trois semaines


# landmark

```{r}


landmarks |> 
  mutate(
    m_d = month(DEBUT_CW),
    d_d = day(DEBUT_CW),
    fake_year_d = if_else(
      (m_d > 8) | (m_d == 8 & d_d >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    date_d = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_d, m_d, d_d))) |> 
  select(-c(m_d, d_d, fake_year_d)) |> 
  mutate(
    m_f = month(FIN_CW),
    d_f = day(FIN_CW),
    fake_year_f = if_else(
      (m_f > 8) | (m_f == 8 & d_f >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    date_f = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_f, m_f, d_f))) |> 
  select(-c(m_f, d_f, fake_year_f)) |> 
  mutate(
    m_flo = month(FLORAISON),
    d_flo = day(FLORAISON),
    fake_year_flo = if_else(
      (m_flo > 8) | (m_flo == 8 & d_flo >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    date_flo = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_flo, m_flo, d_flo))) |> 
  select(-c(m_flo, d_flo, fake_year_flo)) |> 
  select(YEAR, ENVIRONNEMENT, date_d, date_f, date_flo) |> 
  pivot_longer(c(date_d, date_f, date_flo), names_to = "date") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +      
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = ENVIRONNEMENT),   
              width = 0.2,
              alpha = 0.6)

landmarks |>

    date_d = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_d, m_d, d_d)),
    m_f = month(FIN_CW),
    d_f = day(FIN_CW),
    fake_year_f = if_else((m_f > 8) | (m_f == 8 & d_f >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    date_f = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_f, m_f, d_f)),
    m_flo = month(FLORAISON),
    d_flo = day(FLORAISON),
    fake_year_flo = if_else((m_flo > 8) | (m_flo == 8 & d_flo >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    date_flo = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_flo, m_flo, d_flo))
  ) |> 
  select(YEAR, ENVIRONNEMENT, date_d, date_f, date_flo) |> 
  pivot_longer(c(date_d, date_f, date_flo),
               names_to = "type_date",
               values_to = "value") |> 

  ggplot(aes(x = type_date, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +      
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = ENVIRONNEMENT),   
              width = 0.2,
              alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal()
```
